Title: Microsoft introduces AppSource for SaaS business apps

Body.Content: AppSource helps users find and evaluate SaaS apps unique to their industry and line-of-business role, built by ISV partners on top of Dynamics, Office, and the Azure platform. Users can also discover content packs and add-ins for Microsoft business apps, like Dynamics CRM, Power BI, and Office. For more information, please visit the AppSource page.
